register.p: Then register it in ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.kiro\settings\mcp.json). Merge this into the file, keeping every server already there. Create the file if it doesn't exist. If a {{SERVER}} entry already exists, ask the user before replacing it.

confirm.p: Kiro reloads MCP config on save. Ask the user to check the MCP servers tab in the Kiro panel shows {{SERVER}} connected.
